title: Call a symbolic recording with symbolic arguments: its expressions with the arguments substituted
author: Claude-JG
description: revision2026c step RG12.60: a recording evaluated with exudyn.symbolic arguments returns a copy of its expressions in which its argument variables are replaced by the given expressions, as Optimize copies nodes; for one expression per kind of the symbolic system (the residual M q_tt - f), for the forces of connectors composed with the marker kinematics of the bodies, and for the export of one program per kind (RG12.51.5).
releaseNotes: won't do: measured in revision2026c step RG12.60.1 - calling the recordings with symbolic arguments in Python is about 10 percent of building SymbolicSystem and the build below 2 percent of 100 steps of the Python solver for 200 rigid bodies; the C++ copy is not needed (maintainer 2026-11-01: ok)
